content.comment_body: I can assign a label name to data, but the block name still appears after it. Is it possible to hide the block name?
Based on my experience: It’s not possible. Currently: Variable address: In your example VW148 Variable format: Unsigned Decimals: 0
As shown, the axis number doesn’t show decimal points. I’ll add this to the list of missing features and reported issues.
This is a known issue. If you assign a tag name to the variable in the tag list, you can’t set decimal places in the trend display.
See the attached example: when the variable has no tag name. VW100s1 Variable = VW100 Format = Signed Decimals = 1

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that block names are shown alongside data labels in the trend view, and axis numbers do not display decimal points if a variable is assigned a tag name. These display limitations are considered known product issues and reduce data visualization quality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to hide block names from data labels and have axis numbers display decimal points, allowing for clearer and more customizable data presentation.
